content:
maria_tech: Quick heads-up — post-deploy synthetic run for v2.14.0 flagged a small cluster of transient 5xxs and p95 latency jump on the text-generation short-prompt cohort in us-west2.

deploybot: Deploy completed: v2.14.0 -> us-west2 (canary=10%). Postdeploy synths launched.

sanjay: noticing the same. p95 went from ~120ms -> ~980ms for prompts <= 12 tokens. Errors are 502/503-ish from inference-proxy.

alex_w: do we have a sample log / snippet for the failing request? can you paste the synth trace?

sanjay: paste of synth trace:
```
SYNTH-ID: abcd1234
route: text-gen-short
prompt: "hi"
error: inference-proxy: upstream EOF during decode
latency_ms: 987
host: gw-usw2-12
```

jen-c: ran a quick replay comparison between pinned variant v2.13.3 and v2.14.0 on the same host pool:
`curl -X POST ... --data '@short_prompts.json'`
Result summary:
- v2.13.3 p95=128ms, error_rate=0.1%
- v2.14.0 p95=972ms, error_rate=2.4%

qa-bot: Synthetic coverage: 12 failing samples out of 512 checks, all in bucket "short_prompts" (<=12 tokens). Tokenizer diff observed in 9/12 failures.

maria_tech: thanks. sounds like a regression affecting short-token paths (maybe tokenizer / kv cache interaction). ops-oncall, any immediate impact to customers? metrics?

ops-oncall: customer-facing error rate for generation routes in us-west2 up from 0.03% -> 0.6% in last 10m. No broad SLA breach yet but trending. Recommend pin routing to last stable variant for us-west2 while we triage.

alex_w: +1 pin. We should also start a targeted canary with a conservative tokenizer fallback flag if that's quick to roll (config: token_flex=true).

maria_tech: plan proposal:
1) pin us-west2 routing -> v2.13.3 (immediate)
2) run config-canary (v2.14.0 + token_flex=true) to 5-10% for 15m
3) if canary stable, roll forward with fix; if not, rollback release and schedule hotfix
I'll apply pin now unless objections.

sanjay: no objections. I'll start digging into the tokenizer change diff and run a local reproducer against the quantized kernels.

jen-c: I kicked off the canary job: `deploybot: apply-config-canary token_flex=true target=us-west2 percent=10 duration=15m` — seeing first samples now, baseline p95 ~150ms.

deploybot: routing pin applied: us-west2 -> v2.13.3 (pinned by maria_tech). Config-canary started on v2.14.0 (token_flex=true) at 10%.

ops-oncall: I alerted support and added an incident note. channel #incidents-to-eng created and monitoring pinned.

maria_tech: tracking — will reconvene in 20m or sooner if canary spikes. tagging @sanjay @jen-c for updates. :thumbsup:

ops-oncall: acknowledged. updating runbook with timeline and decision points.

maria_tech: final: pin done, canary running. if stable after 15m we will unpin and proceed with controlled rollout; else rollback. closing thread to reduce noise — post updates here only.
